information: ## This competition has a per-event competitor limit. Please read the [per-competitor event limit page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BerkeleySides2026#81150-per-event-competitor-limit) for more information. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. * Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.
